label: copy phase: k/m/o fed back early (recall 2-3) in long sequences with y earlier
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit (0.03% of steps). Fires only in the copy phase (never during original input or at <DEL>), almost always when the fed-back input is k (58% of mass), m or o; mostly at recall_idx 2-3 (85% of mass) with a smaller bump at the final step of L=9 sequences, and much more in long sequences (L=9 holds 66% of mass). Strongest when the first original token / preceding input is y, q, g, e or a and y appears in the prefix. The coarse rule (copy phase, input k/m/o) covers 83% of mass but with under 1% precision; adding context conditions only lifts F1 to ~0.2, so the gating context is only partly captured. Does not fire on first occurrences of tokens or in short (L<=4) sequences.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=m (+3.43), phase=2 & in_tok=o (+3.34), orig0=y (+2.97), phase=2 & in_tok=k (+2.76), in_tok=k (+2.53), orig0=q (+2.34). Lower it: out_tok=z (-1.86), recall_idx=-1 (-1.50), orig6=- (-1.37), in_first=1 (-1.30).
